title: Smart irrigation technologies improve water use efficiency in rice fields
abstract: Sensor-based irrigation reduced water use and maintained crop yield in irrigated rice fields.

title: Solar dryers improve drying performance and product quality
abstract: A hybrid solar dryer improved drying rate and reduced quality loss compared with open sun drying.

title: Machinery traffic increases soil compaction in cropping systems
outcome: bulk density; penetration resistance; crop yield
